title: Testing and Debugging Python Code
description: Learn how to write tests and debug Python programs effectively to build reliable and maintainable software.

lessons.title: Introduction to Testing
lessons.content: Testing verifies that your code behaves as expected. It helps catch bugs early and improves code quality.

lessons.title: Types of Testing
lessons.content: Common types include unit testing (test individual functions), integration testing (test combined parts), and system testing (test entire application).

lessons.title: Using unittest Module
Writing Effective Test Cases
lessons.content: Good tests cover different inputs, edge cases, and expected errors. Tests should be clear, isolated, and repeatable.

lessons.title: Introduction to pytest
lessons.content:
pytest is a popular testing framework with simpler syntax:
```python
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

def test_add():
    assert add(2, 3) == 5
```

lessons.title: Debugging Basics
lessons.content: Debugging is finding and fixing bugs. Common methods include print statements, logging, and using debugging tools.

lessons.title: Using Python’s pdb Debugger
lessons.content:
pdb is a built-in debugger:
```python
import pdb

def buggy_func():
    pdb.set_trace()
    x = 5
    y = 0
    print(x / y)  # Causes error

buggy_func()
```

lessons.title: Logging Best Practices
lessons.content:
Use logging module for better traceability:
```python
import logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG)
logging.debug('Debug message')
```

lessons.title: Handling Exceptions Gracefully
lessons.content: Use try-except blocks to catch and handle errors without crashing programs, improving user experience.

lessons.title: Automating Tests and CI/CD Integration
lessons.content: Automate running tests on every code change using tools like GitHub Actions or Jenkins to maintain code quality continuously.
